question: Raghu and Raman start together to walk a certain equal distance at a speed of 10 km/h and 8 km/h, respectively. Raghu arrives 30 minutes before Raman arrives. Find the distance between the start and the end point.
solution: Given: Speed of Raghu = 10 km/h Speed of Raman = 8 km/h Difference of time taken by Raghu and Raman = 30 minutes Concept: Speed is inversely proportional to time. Formula Used: Distance = Speed × Time Calculation: As per question,
